title: GrantKit affiliate partners (MASTER-PLAN 1.13, D19)
description: Public partner registry. trackingUrl is the public programme landing/tracking URL and is never a secret; postback secrets live only in the AFFILIATE_POSTBACK_SECRET env var (OPS.md). Placement on pages is decided by server/offers/placement.ts (Phase 2.9). In Phase 1 this file is rendered on /trust as names + disclosure only.

domain.description: One of the 11 domains in shared/domains.ts minus NEVER_MONETIZE.domains (legal_status, mental_health, safety_rights).

excludedStatuses.description: Client-side statuses (D6) for which this partner is never shown. PIVOT.md §6 rule 4: asylum_seeker and undocumented are always excluded.

trackingUrl.description: Public https URL of the programme landing/tracking link, or the placeholder TODO-after-registration until the operator registers (OPS.md, Affiliate accounts).
